headline: The Fed is likely to raise interest rates as inflation persists. What that means for consumers
detail: Higher rates increase borrowing costs and reduce the present value of future earnings, directly hurting your tech/chip growth stocks. This environment amplifies margin risks for your concentrated portfolio.
rec: Consider trimming SMH (-14.39%) and QQQI (-3.62%) to reduce exposure to rate-sensitive assets.

headline: 10-year Treasury yield hits 5% for first time since 2023 as traders brace for Fed decision this week
detail: Rising yields make bonds more attractive, drawing capital away from growth stocks. This puts significant pressure on your concentrated tech/chip portfolio, especially leveraged positions.
rec: Review SOXL (-59.15%) and SPAL (-30.36%) stops. Consider cutting these highly leveraged positions to manage risk in this rising yield environment.

headline: Brent crude tops $106 after Saudi Arabia shuts down critical pipeline that bypasses Strait of Hormuz
detail: Surging oil prices contribute to inflation, which can push the Fed to raise rates further, negatively impacting your tech holdings. However, it creates a strong tailwind for energy stocks.
rec: Consider a small, diversified position in energy. GUSH (entry 47.87-47.82, stop 47.45) or XLE (entry 64.62-64.56, stop 64.35) have scanner long setups.
